pages.title: Strange & Charm Quarks
pages.text: The second generation: copies of the up and down with more mass and new quantum numbers, strangeness and charm. Outside strange matter they decay in a fraction of an instant through the weak force. These are held together, faintly fizzing, as if impatient to become something lighter.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Sorting virtual quarks by mass, I noticed a heavier pair in the Spectrometer's readout. The charm quark took experimentalists by surprise in 1974; it took me by surprise too, until the helium cooled them enough to keep.
